terminology_caveats: Gemini Notebook is kept in Latin script in every locale. Particles attach per local convention, with no space in Japanese.

The word for 'notebook' is not verified against Google's official localized terminology. 'cuaderno' (es), 'notebook' (fr, de, pt_BR, it), '노트북' (ko), 'ノートブック' (ja), '笔记本' (zh_CN), '筆記本' (zh_TW), and 'नोटबुक' (hi) are reasonable choices that should be aligned with the extension's existing glossary.
Register varies by locale convention: informal tú/tu in es and it, formal vous and Sie in fr and de, você-style 'Confira' in pt_BR. Match whatever the existing locale files already use.
'Request' is rendered as '요청', 'リクエスト', 'solicitud', 'demande', 'Anfrage', 'solicitação', '请求', 'richiesta', '要求' (zh_TW), and 'अनुरोध'. These should stay consistent with other queue strings.

The short labels ('Génération en cours', 'Generazione in corso', 'जनरेट हो रहा है') are the longest candidates and should be checked for truncation at 320px, with the shorter fallbacks noted in the rationale.
These translations have not been reviewed by native speakers and were not checked against Google's live interface.
